name: Ajax Login and Register Modal
description: Renders core's user login, registration and password-reset forms inside an AJAX modal / off-canvas dialog, plus a block of dialog-opening links for anonymous visitors.
project_description: Ajax Login and Register Modal presents Drupal core's user login (user_login_form), registration (user_register_form) and password-reset (user_pass) forms inside an AJAX modal, non-modal, or off-canvas dialog instead of on a full page. It works entirely through hook_form_alter: it wraps the three core forms, adds an inline status-messages region, attaches an #ajax submit callback, and shows an admin-configured success dialog (or redirect/reload) when submission succeeds. A companion block ('ajax_login_register_modal_block') renders a set of dialog-opening links (login / register / reset) for anonymous users only. All authentication itself is still performed by core's own form validators and submit handlers; this module only changes how those forms are presented and where the user lands afterwards. Four admin forms under Configuration expose per-form modal titles, dimensions, button text, success titles/messages, extra in-modal links, and redirect behaviour.
